templates.title: Golden groove
templates.prompt: Create a natural, rhythmic dance with fluid full-body movement and a steady camera. Keep the person recognizable.

templates.title: City moves
templates.prompt: Animate a relaxed urban dance, with natural body motion and steady framing.

templates.title: Studio rhythm
templates.prompt: Animate a graceful dance, keeping facial features and clothing consistent.

templates.title: Together in motion
templates.prompt: Create a gentle synchronized dance with natural movement.

templates.title: A moment, alive
templates.prompt: Bring this photograph to life with subtle smiles, a gentle breeze, and a slow cinematic camera movement. Preserve the people and the mood.

templates.title: A familiar smile
templates.prompt: Animate this portrait with a warm smile and natural blinking. Keep the camera steady and preserve facial identity.

templates.title: Birthday glow
templates.prompt: Create a joyful birthday scene with warm light and softly falling confetti.

templates.title: Just us
templates.prompt: Animate an affectionate moment with soft sunset light, natural expressions, and a gentle camera push-in.

templates.title: City escape
templates.prompt: Create a cinematic travel moment with a gentle tracking shot and lively background.

templates.title: Golden afternoon
templates.prompt: Animate a relaxed afternoon in a flower field with a gentle breeze and warm sunshine.

templates.title: Forever begins
templates.prompt: Create an elegant wedding-inspired scene with soft floral details and romantic light.

templates.title: Playful companion
templates.prompt: Animate the pet with playful, natural movement and a gentle breeze. Preserve its appearance and keep the camera steady.

templates.title: Soft light
templates.prompt: Create an editorial studio portrait with a warm neutral backdrop and soft directional light. Preserve the face and natural skin texture.

templates.title: Neon nights
templates.prompt: Create a cinematic portrait on a neon-lit city street with blue and magenta bokeh, preserving facial identity.

templates.title: Golden muse
templates.prompt: Create a sunlit editorial portrait with warm golden-hour light and natural flowers.

templates.title: Two of a kind
templates.prompt: Create a warm, realistic studio portrait of the couple with natural expressions.

templates.title: Tiny world
templates.prompt: Create a playful miniature-world portrait with oversized everyday objects. Keep it lighthearted and realistic.

templates.title: Your next chapter
templates.prompt: Create a graduation portrait with a tasteful gown and cap, soft campus background, and natural lighting.

templates.title: Memories restored
templates.prompt: Restore this photograph with natural detail, balanced colors, and preserved identities.

templates.title: An evening to remember
templates.prompt: Create an elegant evening portrait with formal attire and soft cinematic lighting.

templates.title: Birthday wishes
templates.prompt: Create a joyful birthday portrait with flowers and warm, festive details.

templates.title: Golden together
templates.prompt: Create a romantic golden-hour portrait with natural expressions and soft greenery.

templates.title: First impression
templates.prompt: Create a professional headshot with a clean background, polished business attire, and natural facial detail.
